description_text: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
historical_description: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
filing_description: Altair Engineering Inc. is a global leader in computational science and artificial intelligence enabling organizations across broad industry segments to drive smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world.
rationale: Altair’s pre-deal portfolio included AI/data science, MLOps, AutoML and machine-learning workflows, but simulation/design and HPC remained major products that function without ML. AI was an important capability and product line, not clearly the defining target-level product.
counterevidence_notes: Strong AI/ML portfolio and proprietary data-science tooling; no evidence that AI-specific products dominated total revenue.

description_text: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
historical_description: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
filing_description: Nuance Communications, Inc. is a technology pioneer and market leader in conversational AI and ambient clinical intelligence.
rationale: Pre-deal SEC filings describe Nuance as a conversational/cognitive AI leader and identify automated speech recognition, natural-language understanding, dialog management and clinical documentation as core offerings. Speech/language models are integral to what these products sell, and historical filings establish persistence well beyond 12 months.
counterevidence_notes: The company also sold implementation/services and workflow applications, but the underlying speech/NLP technology is central to its commercial offering.

description_text: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. Our observability platform combines metrics, events, logs, traces, and other telemetry data with our proprietary stack of analytical tools to rapidly generate actionable, fact-based insights.
historical_description: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. Our observability platform combines metrics, events, logs, traces, and other telemetry data with our proprietary stack of analytical tools to rapidly generate actionable, fact-based insights.
filing_description: New Relic is a leading “all-in-one” observability platform that enables our customers to plan, build, deploy, and operate their critical digital infrastructure by harnessing the power of data. Our observability platform combines metrics, events, logs, traces, and other telemetry data with our proprietary stack of analytical tools to rapidly generate actionable, fact-based insights.
rationale: New Relic’s observability platform added machine-learning anomaly detection, AI-assisted incident response and probable-root-cause guidance. Telemetry ingestion, querying and monitoring still work without those models, and no AI-specific material-revenue evidence was found.
counterevidence_notes: Applied Intelligence and automated anomaly/root-cause capabilities are meaningful differentiators, but the platform’s primary value remains telemetry observability.

description_text: Our mission is to help people see and understand data. Our software products put the power of data into the hands of everyday people, allowing a broad population of business users to engage with their data, ask questions, solve problems and create value.
historical_description: Our mission is to help people see and understand data. Our software products put the power of data into the hands of everyday people, allowing a broad population of business users to engage with their data, ask questions, solve problems and create value.
filing_description: Our mission is to help people see and understand data. Our software products put the power of data into the hands of everyday people, allowing a broad population of business users to engage with their data, ask questions, solve problems and create value.
rationale: At announcement, Tableau’s core was visual business intelligence and data visualization. Ask Data’s natural-language querying had launched only a few months earlier, making AI an enabling feature rather than an essential function; the 12-month persistence test therefore fails.
counterevidence_notes: Ask Data was a real natural-language capability at announcement; later Explain Data material was not used because it post-dated the cutoff.

description_text: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
historical_description: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
filing_description: We have pioneered a new category of software, the Intelligent Data Management Cloud, or IDMC. We deliver innovation-led products powered by the industry leading artificial intelligence
rationale: Informatica’s CLAIRE engine applied metadata-driven AI and machine learning to recommendations and automation in data management. The main platform remained broader data integration, governance and quality software, so AI enabled the product rather than defining the whole company’s core function.
counterevidence_notes: CLAIRE is a named proprietary AI engine and was present years before the deal, but AI functions were embedded in a larger integration/data-management suite.

description_text: PROS provides software solutions that optimize shopping and selling experiences for both business-to-business ... companies across industry verticals in more than 80 countries. Our solutions leverage proprietary artificial intelligence ... and automation to help drive profitable growth at scale
historical_description: PROS provides software solutions that optimize shopping and selling experiences for both business-to-business ... companies across industry verticals in more than 80 countries. Our solutions leverage proprietary artificial intelligence ... and automation to help drive profitable growth at scale
filing_description: PROS provides software solutions that optimize shopping and selling experiences for both business-to-business ... companies across industry verticals in more than 80 countries. Our solutions leverage proprietary artificial intelligence ... and automation to help drive profitable growth at scale
rationale: PROS’s pre-announcement 2024 Form 10-K describes proprietary AI/ML, neural networks and reinforcement learning as the engine for price optimization, demand forecasting and airline revenue optimization. These predictive/prescriptive algorithms are intrinsic to the monetized product offering, and historical research/ML positioning is well established.
counterevidence_notes: PROS also sells CPQ, distribution and digital-offer products, and it does not disclose a separate AI revenue split; however, AI/ML is foundational to its central pricing and optimization offerings.

description_text: Medidata is a global life sciences technology provider, dedicated to improving the way clinical research is designed, conducted, analyzed, and commercialized. Our cloud-based platform of solutions, data analytics, and AI enables efficiency and improves quality throughout clinical development programs by accelerating processes, enhancing decision-making, minimizing operational risk, reducing costs, and transforming trial strategies.
historical_description: Medidata is a global life sciences technology provider, dedicated to improving the way clinical research is designed, conducted, analyzed, and commercialized. Our cloud-based platform of solutions, data analytics, and AI enables efficiency and improves quality throughout clinical development programs by accelerating processes, enhancing decision-making, minimizing operational risk, reducing costs, and transforming trial strategies.
filing_description: Medidata is a global life sciences technology provider, dedicated to improving the way clinical research is designed, conducted, analyzed, and commercialized. Our cloud-based platform of solutions, data analytics, and AI enables efficiency and improves quality throughout clinical development programs by accelerating processes, enhancing decision-making, minimizing operational risk, reducing costs, and transforming trial strategies.
rationale: Medidata launched Acorn AI in April 2019, using its clinical-trial data assets and data-science capabilities for pharmaceutical research insights. The flagship business remained clinical-trial software, and the named AI initiative was announced less than 12 months before the deal, so persistence does not pass.
counterevidence_notes: Large clinical-trial datasets and a dedicated Acorn AI organization support technical capability; AI was nevertheless a new branded product area and not shown to drive material company revenue.

description_text: Duck Creek Technologies is the leading cloud-based SaaS provider of core systems for the global property and casualty (P&C) and general insurance industry.
historical_description: Duck Creek Technologies is the leading cloud-based SaaS provider of core systems for the global property and casualty (P&C) and general insurance industry.
filing_description: Duck Creek Technologies is the leading cloud-based SaaS provider of core systems for the global property and casualty (P&C) and general insurance industry.
rationale: The pre-deal 2022 Form 10-K describes cloud SaaS core systems for insurance policy administration, billing, claims, rating and underwriting. The reviewed pre-announcement evidence does not document AI/ML as a product dependency, proprietary AI asset or material revenue driver.
counterevidence_notes: The company’s later agentic/AI underwriting products are outside the January 2023 cutoff and were not counted.

description_text: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. Our integrated suite of products works together to help organizations build people-centric security and compliance programs.
historical_description: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. Our integrated suite of products works together to help organizations build people-centric security and compliance programs.
filing_description: Proofpoint is a leading next-generation cybersecurity company that enables primarily large and mid-sized organizations worldwide to protect the way their people work from advanced threats and compliance risks. Our integrated suite of products works together to help organizations build people-centric security and compliance programs.
rationale: Proofpoint documented machine learning in the Nexus People Risk Explorer risk model and threat-telemetry analysis. These features improve its cybersecurity/compliance suite, but email/cloud security remains broader than AI; the cited named-model release was only about seven months before the announcement.
counterevidence_notes: Proofpoint had broad threat data and ML-based risk analysis, but the source identified for this pass does not establish qualifying AI positioning by April 2020.

description_text: We are a leading cloud-based enterprise event management company, with over 15,800 customers worldwide. Our mission is to transform the way our customers manage meetings and events, and enhance the experience of our customers' customer - the event attendee.
historical_description: We are a leading cloud-based enterprise event management company, with over 15,800 customers worldwide. Our mission is to transform the way our customers manage meetings and events, and enhance the experience of our customers' customer - the event attendee.
filing_description: We are a leading cloud-based enterprise event management company, with over 15,800 customers worldwide. Our mission is to transform the way our customers manage meetings and events, and enhance the experience of our customers' customer - the event attendee.
rationale: Cvent’s pre-deal Form 10-K describes Event Cloud and Hospitality Cloud products for event planning, registration, venue sourcing and event management. The reviewed contemporaneous disclosure does not identify AI/ML as a core or enabling product feature.
counterevidence_notes: Later AI survey/event-writing and chatbot capabilities should not be backdated to the 2016 target state.

description_text: Envestnet, through its subsidiaries, is transforming the way financial advice and insight are delivered.
historical_description: Envestnet, through its subsidiaries, is transforming the way financial advice and insight are delivered.
filing_description: Envestnet, through its subsidiaries, is transforming the way financial advice and insight are delivered.
rationale: Envestnet’s FY2023 Form 10-K describes wealth-management technology, financial planning, asset allocation, portfolio tools, data aggregation and analytics. The filing does not document AI/ML as a product dependency or identify proprietary models/material AI revenue, so generic ‘intelligence’ and analytics language is not enough to code AI.
counterevidence_notes: Portfolio analytics and algorithmic allocation could contain quantitative methods, but no source-specific machine-learning evidence was documented for this target date.

description_text: Couchbase is the developer data platform for critical applications in our AI world. Our mission is to inspire and empower developers and architects as they build, deploy and run critical applications and AI agents spanning from the cloud to the edge and everywhere in between.
historical_description: Couchbase is the developer data platform for critical applications in our AI world. Our mission is to inspire and empower developers and architects as they build, deploy and run critical applications and AI agents spanning from the cloud to the edge and everywhere in between.
filing_description: Couchbase is the developer data platform for critical applications in our AI world. Our mission is to inspire and empower developers and architects as they build, deploy and run critical applications and AI agents spanning from the cloud to the edge and everywhere in between.
rationale: Couchbase Server 7.6 added vector search and integrations for semantic search/RAG in March 2024, more than 12 months before the announcement. The main NoSQL database remains useful without AI, and the documented workflow uses chosen external embedding models/LLMs rather than Couchbase’s own trained models.
counterevidence_notes: The vector-search feature materially supports AI applications, but it is an addition to a broad database platform and does not show model ownership or AI-specific revenue.

description_text: Momentive Global Inc. (the "Company") is a leader in agile experience management, providing Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") solutions that help businesses collect and analyze stakeholder sentiment at scale. (verbatim fragments, joined)
historical_description: Momentive Global Inc. (the "Company") is a leader in agile experience management, providing Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") solutions that help businesses collect and analyze stakeholder sentiment at scale. (verbatim fragments, joined)
filing_description: Momentive Global Inc. (the "Company") is a leader in agile experience management, providing Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") solutions that help businesses collect and analyze stakeholder sentiment at scale. (verbatim fragments, joined)
rationale: A July 2021 company release describes Momentive’s AI-powered research solutions, so some AI-enabled survey/research capability predates the deal by more than 12 months. The core offering remains survey/experience-management SaaS; no proprietary model asset or material AI-specific revenue was identified.
counterevidence_notes: The pre-deal source uses ‘AI-powered’ language but gives limited technical detail about proprietary models or AI-attributable revenue.

AI is central to the CX-automation/bot offering, although the company does not disclose a separate AI revenue share.
counterevidence_notes: Verint’s broader portfolio includes conventional workforce/customer engagement and analytics tools; models are mixed-source and AI-specific revenue is not separately disclosed.

The Alteryx Analytics Automation Platform empowers analytics for all by delivering easy, end-to-end automation of data engineering, analytics, reporting, machine learning, and data science processes, enabling enterprises to democratize data analytics across their organizations for a broad range of use cases.
historical_description: We are a leader in analytics automation. The Alteryx Analytics Automation Platform empowers analytics for all by delivering easy, end-to-end automation of data engineering, analytics, reporting, machine learning, and data science processes, enabling enterprises to democratize data analytics across their organizations for a broad range of use cases.
rationale: Alteryx offered ML/AutoML, NLP, OCR, model training/explainability and AI-driven insight products before the deal. These are commercial capabilities within a broader analytics-automation platform; data preparation and workflow automation still function without ML, and no AI-specific revenue split was documented.
counterevidence_notes: Alteryx Machine Learning and Intelligence Suite are genuine products, but the wider business remains analytics automation, data engineering and reporting.

Our mission is to be the leading software-as-a-service analytics platform for reliable and secure cloud-native applications. With our platform, we help our customers ensure application reliability, secure and protect against modern security threats, and gain insights into their cloud infrastructure.
historical_description: Sumo Logic empowers the people who power modern, digital businesses. Our mission is to be the leading software-as-a-service analytics platform for reliable and secure cloud-native applications. filing_description: Sumo Logic empowers the people who power modern, digital businesses. Our mission is to be the leading software-as-a-service analytics platform for reliable and secure cloud-native applications. With our platform, we help our customers ensure application reliability, secure and protect against modern security threats, and gain insights into their cloud infrastructure.
rationale: Sumo Logic’s FY2021 Form 10-K says its Continuous Intelligence Platform uses AI/ML to analyze application, infrastructure, security and IoT data. The platform remains a log/analytics and security service without those capabilities, and the filing does not describe a sufficiently specific proprietary trained-model asset or AI-attributable revenue.
counterevidence_notes: AI/ML is part of the analytics proposition, but the source’s description is broad and does not identify model architecture or separate AI revenue.

description_text: Marketo serves as a strategic marketing partner to more than 4,500 large and medium enterprises and small companies across a wide variety of industries. Our applications are complemented by the Marketo Marketing Nation, a thriving network of more than 550 third-party solutions through our LaunchPoint ecosystem and over 60,000 marketers who share and learn from each other to grow their collective marketing expertise.
historical_description: Marketo serves as a strategic marketing partner to more than 4,500 large and medium enterprises and small companies across a wide variety of industries. filing_description: Marketo serves as a strategic marketing partner to more than 4,500 large and medium enterprises and small companies across a wide variety of industries. Our applications are complemented by the Marketo Marketing Nation, a thriving network of more than 550 third-party solutions through our LaunchPoint ecosystem and over 60,000 marketers who share and learn from each other to grow their collective marketing expertise.
rationale: Marketo’s Real-Time Personalization predictive-content feature used machine-learning/predictive-analytics algorithms to recommend content, but the broader product was marketing automation. The cited release is from June 2015, just under 12 months before the May 31, 2016 announcement, so persistence fails.
counterevidence_notes: Predictive recommendations were a monetizable product feature, but the source does not establish material AI revenue or that Marketo’s core marketing automation depended on ML.

description_text: Talend is a leader in data integration and data integrity. We operate on the principle that delivering clean, complete, uncompromised, and trusted data - in real time - empowers businesses to make critical decisions with confidence.
historical_description: Talend is a leader in data integration and data integrity. We operate on the principle that delivering clean, complete, uncompromised, and trusted data - in real time - empowers businesses to make critical decisions with confidence.
filing_description: Talend is a leader in data integration and data integrity. We operate on the principle that delivering clean, complete, uncompromised, and trusted data - in real time - empowers businesses to make critical decisions with confidence.
rationale: Talend’s pre-deal Form 10-K documents machine-learning-enabled deduplication, validation and standardization in Talend Data Quality, as well as AI-enabled data matching. These were embedded/optional capabilities within a broader data integration and data-fabric platform.
counterevidence_notes: ML-enabled data quality is explicit, but it is an add-on/embedded functionality and not a product whose essential purpose is an AI model.
